title: Preserve captured baselines across objective edits and bound assessment history
summary: Repair the two KS-1126 receiving failures: historical captured context must not become a current evaluation requirement after a benign objective revision, and repeated assessments must not recursively embed their ancestors until the normal input budget fails.
in_scope: Reproduce capture, objective revision and subsequent same-subject capture under present access and source controls. Preserve actual conveyed history and current edit/revocation guards.

Bound assessment record size by referencing the durable original captured input rather than recursively embedding full publication in every derived record. Preserve exact journal replay, input-artifact reconstruction and old record readability.
Ten successive synthetic same-subject developments under one lens with prepared sizes retained; real-world source bodies remain outside this repository.
out_of_scope: StateCivics authentication, stack changes, host implementation, production reads/deployment, accumulation cadence and encrypted-backup decisions.
Raising the 2 MiB host limit, dropping baselines, weakening source ACLs, stale-work admission, new retrieval/storage infrastructure, live calls or provider qualification.
implementation: Reuse existing assessment journals/current lanes and the existing native attention and optional study paths. Keep monitoring 1.0/1.1 available.
Separate present action/egress guards from historical conveyed-material inspection; old context pins must not be rebound or treated as current. Document any receiving-host change explicitly.
Retain pre-fix failures, post-fix behavioral evidence, source/package pins and review before release.

acceptance.criterion: A prior capture remains an honest baseline after an approved objective revision.
acceptance.verification: Capture, revise objective, then capture a new same-subject development; verify old evidence/history remains exact, duplicate silence still applies, and in-flight edit, revoke, foreign scope and forbidden baseline reads still refuse.

acceptance.criterion: Ten successive same-subject captures stay within the unchanged 2 MiB input budget.
acceptance.verification: Record prepared input size per step with explicitly authored synthetic changes; every step completes; assert non-recursive assessment representation, exact input-artifact digest/reconstruction, truthful budget refusal and command recovery.

acceptance.criterion: A versioned receiving handoff distinguishes SDK repair from host acceptance.
acceptance.verification: Run affected currentness/access/attention/publication/study regressions, independent review and installed SDK checks. Document exact required host changes and package identity; StateCivics owns the repeated timeline and real-form acceptance.

tests: Capture, revise objective, then new same-subject capture.
Ten successive same-subject developments with unchanged budget and per-step input sizes.
Exact journal/input-artifact recovery; currentness, revocation, foreign access, duplicate suppression and old record compatibility.
risks: Historical access is not current evaluation authority; a fix must not admit stale current inputs or skip present READ/egress restrictions.
Removing duplicated publication bytes must preserve durable exact reconstruction and old assessment readability.

reuse.application: Reuse the existing journal, authority and access owners; add no replacement storage.

sources: StateCivics KS-1126 receiving record at 73732c7e3; authored timeline and API half are distinct from real-form acceptance.
